messages:
erin: Quick async follow-up from the PM on last night's KV-cache OOM. Need owners + short validation steps so SRE can gate the canary.

zack: I ran a short prod-replay and saw small-object fragmentation rising steadily; uploaded heapdiffs: https://redwood/s/INC-2150/heapdiffs.zip

priya: suggestion: minimal set = profiling, GC probe, soft-admit, compactor, canary with strict rollback gates. owners below.

erin: ACTIONS (minimal measurable):
1) Profiling & flamegraphs (owner: zack) - run staging replay, attach pprof and flamegraphs to INC-2150. due: 2026-03-28
2) GC probe (owner: priya) - test GOGC=180 / SetGCPercent(180) feature-flagged; report heaplive, pause, p99. due: 2026-03-29
3) Soft admission + metric (owner: mohit) - add kv.soft_limit_pct and kv_soft_rejects_total, include README. due: 2026-03-30
4) Tiny-object compactor (owner: zack) - opt-in compactor every 4h; expose kv_compaction_runs. due: 2026-04-01
5) Canary plan & SRE gates (owner: erin) - canary 2% -> 10% with auto-rollback on error_rate>0.6% OR kv_fragmentation_ratio>0.78 OR p99+60ms. due: 2026-03-28

mohit: i'll open a draft PR for soft-admit and include validation steps for oncall. snippet: kv.soft_limit_pct=80, kv.soft_reject_policy=evict_oldest

priya: profiling commands i'll use: `GOMAXPROCS=4 ./server --replay=staging && pprof -svg server.alloc > /tmp/alloc.svg`

sre-bot: notice: scheduled canary window reserved by @erin at 1868005650 — 03-28 00:00-02:00 UTC

zack: uploaded flamegraphs and heap diffs to INC-2150/artifacts. initial note: high retention from `transformer.dedupe` and many short-lived byte slices.

mohit: PR opened: https://redwood/pull/INF-3802-PR1 (soft-admit + metrics + README). starting canary now.

sre-bot: deploy started: canary-kv-softadmit by @mohit at 1868005700 — route 2% | sha: a1b2c3d

erin: SRE: please watch error_rate, p99 latency, and kv_fragmentation_ratio. rollback policy: immediate if any gate breached.

sre-bot: alert: kv_fragmentation_ratio crossed 0.79 on prod-2 at 1868005765 — paging SRE

erin: halting canary expansion; SRE please validate correlation. rolling canary back to 0% until thumbs up.

mohit: rolling canary to 0%: `deploy --tag canary-kv-softadmit --route=0%`

sre-bot: deploy updated: canary-kv-softadmit route 0% at 1868005810 by @mohit

erin: I'll update the postmortem follow-up sheet with these owners and schedule a 20m follow-up to review telemetry. If anyone needs to reassign, ping me here. Thanks.

priya: will prepare GC probe PR and include pause/heap graphs.

zack: will iterate on compactor and pooling patch.

erin: closing async thread for now.
